sql:
SELECT e.id,e.kind,e.namespace,e.value,e.locator,
search_fts.rank AS score,d.id AS document_id,search_fts.rowid AS fts_rowid
FROM search_fts JOIN documents d ON d.id=search_fts.document_id
JOIN entries e ON e.id=search_fts.entry_id WHERE search_fts MATCH ?1
AND e.conflicted=0 AND d.status IN ('generated_from_evidence','source_backed')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM entry_evidence v WHERE v.entry_id=e.id AND v.status='source_backed')
AND (?2 IS NULL OR e.kind=?2) AND (?3 IS NULL OR e.namespace=?3)
ORDER BY search_fts.rank LIMIT 10001
python_explain: SEARCH d USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH e USING INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (rowid=?)
SEARCH v USING COVERING INDEX entry_evidence_entry (entry_id=? AND status=?)

descriptions.title: alice's_adventures_in_wonderland
descriptions.original:
A book duology by English author [[Lewis Carroll]] as well as a large media franchise which resulted from them, tagged here with the name of the first book.

The first book, [i]Alice's Adventures in Wonderland[/i] (1865), tells the story of a girl named Alice, who falls down a rabbit hole into a fantasy world populated by peculiar and anthropomorphic creatures. [i]Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There[/i] (1871) is a continuation in which Alice goes through the titular looking glass and enters a world that works like a chess board. Once again, Alice finds various peculiar and anthropomorphic creatures and has to deal with their eccentricities.

Between the original story arriving in Japan just as the country was opening up in the late 1800s and the extremely popular [[Disney]] adaptation, the story has remained as a permanent part of Japanese literature and fashion. 

h4. Characters

* [[Alice (alice in wonderland)|]]
* [[Caterpillar (alice in wonderland)|]]

* [[Queen of Hearts (alice in wonderland)|]]
* [[Red Queen]]

descriptions.original:
A book duology by English author [[Lewis Carroll]] as well as a large media franchise which resulted from them, tagged here with the name of the first book.

The first book, [i]Alice's Adventures in Wonderland[/i] (1865), tells the story of a girl named Alice, who falls down a rabbit hole into a fantasy world populated by peculiar and anthropomorphic creatures. [i]Through the Looking-Glass, and What Alice Found There[/i] (1871) is a continuation in which Alice goes through the titular looking glass and enters a world that works like a chess board. Once again, Alice finds various peculiar and anthropomorphic creatures and has to deal with their eccentricities.

Between the original story arriving in Japan just as the country was opening up in the late 1800s and the extremely popular [[Disney]] adaptation, the story has remained as a permanent part of Japanese literature and fashion. 

h4. Characters

* [[Alice (alice in wonderland)|]]
* [[Caterpillar (alice in wonderland)|]]
* [[Cheshire Cat (alice In Wonderland)|]]
* [[Dodo (alice in wonderland)|]]

* [[Mad Hatter (alice In Wonderland)|]]
* [[March Hare (alice In Wonderland)|]]
* [[Queen of Hearts (alice in wonderland)|]]
* [[Red Queen]]
* [[Tweedledee (alice in wonderland)|]]
